name: split_at_mut_unchecked
declaration: const unsafe fn split_at_mut_unchecked (& mut self , mid : usize) -> (& mut str , & mut str)
documentation:
Divides one string slice into two at an index.

 # Safety

 The caller must ensure that `mid` is a valid byte offset from the start
 of the string and falls on the boundary of a UTF-8 code point.
rules: The caller must ensure that `mid` is a valid byte offset from the start of `self` and falls on the boundary of a UTF-8 code point.
